English: Reed Shelter
Simple communal shelters raised from local reeds, allowing more settlers to weather the jungles storms and humidity.
Clearing Hut
A rough shelter and tool station for initial settlement, assisting with jungle clearing and basic resource gathering.
Jungle Palisade
A defensive palisade of sharpened logs, adapted for the jungle, offering protection from wild beasts and raiders.
Raised Pathway
Elevated wooden walkways link key areas, improving movement and reducing loss of goods to mud and floods.
Canopy Platform
Platforms built high in the jungle canopy for lookout, safe storage, and rapid signaling across the settlement.
Bamboo Bridge
Sturdy bridges of woven bamboo span streams and ravines, expanding urban reach and facilitating trade and patrols.
Jungle Storehouse
Large, elevated warehouses protect goods from humidity, pests, and theft, bolstering city prosperity and trade security.
Jungle Watchtower
Tall timber towers overlook the jungle for miles, providing advance warning of threats and boosting local defenses and administration.
Jungle Trading Post
A bustling commercial hub, drawing merchants from afar with exotic jungle goods and improved market protections.
Grand Jungle Compound
A sprawling, fortified urban center, boasting market courts, high palisades, and advanced jungle logistics, true heart of the jungle city.
